title: Interactions of hypervalent IF5 and XeF4O molecules via σ-hole site with Lewis bases and anions: a comparative ab initio study
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,29811-29821
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04648C, Paper
Open Access

Mahmoud A. A. Ibrahim, Asmaa M. M. Mahmoud, Rehab R. A. Saeed, Mohammed N. I. Shehata, Tamer Shoeib, Jabir H. Al-Fahemi
Interactions of hypervalent IF5 and XeF4O molecules within the square pyramidal geometry via σ-hole site with Lewis bases (LB = NH3 and NCH) and anions (X− = F−, Cl−, Br−, and I−) were comparatively investigated using ab initio methods.
